name: Transformer cooling stage-two request
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
summary: Requests the next defined cooling group when the selected control condition is reached.
description: Requests the next defined cooling group when the selected control condition is reached. Transformer regulation changes the selected winding connection to influence voltage, while cooling control manages the installed fans and pumps. Commands, mechanical position and measured results belong to different parts of the diagram.

In a substation, a voltage regulator can request a tap change and check the resulting tap-position feedback. A separate controller stages cooling equipment according to the transformer manufacturer's defined conditions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Additional cooling demand” at the input and “Second cooling-group command” at the output. A stage number does not establish a thermal rating.

Keep tap-change permission, limit contacts, movement indication and measured voltage distinct. Actual tap positions, time delays, cooling ratings and allowable parallel operation require the selected transformer control design. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
